page.overview:
Who is Charlene Hines?

Charlene Hines is a fictional character created by Canadian author Troy Young for his Nyarlathotep Cycle series of Cthulhu Mythos stories.

A twenty-eight year old woman with an extensive criminal record, at the time of her introduction Charlene is serving a lengthy jail sentence for murder. Her only distinguishing feature is a mole on her chin, which she rubs when she is anxious.

Once a promising student from a wealthy family, Charlene's life was destroyed after she was abducted by a clan of inbred cultists who promised her as a bride to the Great Old One Hastur. Despite making an escape, she ran away from home, falling into a life of drugs and prostitution on the streets. After her pimp mistreated her once too often, she killed him, and was sentenced to prison time.

After five years in jail, Charlene was approached by Harjit Singh of the Department of Extraordinary Phenomena at the suggestion of Adele Kramer. Singh recruited her into the organisation and partnered her with senior investigator Malcolm Mayweather.
